description: The list of traffic flows matching the query

num_connections.description: The number of times this flow was seen

boundary_decision.description: Boundary indicates if the flow was blocked due to an enforcement boundary

draft_policy_decision.description: draft policy decision of the flow

timestamp_range.description: Timestamp ranges for the flow detected

first_detected.description: The first time this flow was detected within the time range specified by the query

last_detected.description: The last time this flow was detected within the time range specified by the query

dst_bo.description: Bytes sent till now by the destination over the flow during the interval

dst_bi.description: Bytes received till now by the destination over the flow during the interval

network.description: PCE network on which this flow was observed.

rules.description: Allow rules for specific policy objects. This is always the draft version.

enforcement_boundaries.description: List of enforcement_boundaries details of the traffic-flow endpoint. This is always the draft version

override_deny_rules.description: List of override deny rules for the traffic flow. This is always the draft version

caps.description: Array of permissions for the flow for the current user

client_type.description: type of client which reported this flow
